declaring_branches.description: Every branch whose manifest (or equivalent) declares this edge.

recency.description: Recency of the most recent declaring branch (RFC3339), if known.

version.description: Resolved version as briefing fact (lockfile), never scored.

EdgeKind.description:
Mechanically collected edge kinds. Dependence kinds count toward fan-in;
association kinds display only (see plan: workflow/docs/xrefs).

Layer.description:
Structural role from *dependence* fan-in/fan-out
(`EdgeKind::is_dependence`: manifest/submodule/registry).

- `Foundation`: depended upon, depends on nothing (`in > 0, out == 0`).
- `Middleware`: both used and using (`in > 0, out > 0`).
- `Application`: top of its chain (`in == 0, out > 0`).
- `Isolated`: no dependence edges either way.

The contract is the stored `Node.layer`, set once by `apply_layers`
and never recomputed: identical in the briefing lane and the public
file, regardless of render. Dependence edges (docs/workflow/xrefs)
never count.

ahead_by.description:
Commits ahead of upstream authored by you (`compare` API + authorship
filter). Rule (a): divergence re-admits forks. Raw ahead counts lie:
a fork frozen while upstream rewrote history shows ahead commits
authored entirely by upstream — those count as pristine, not diverged.

commits_5d.description:
Commit velocity: commits to the default branch in the trailing 5
days (heat) and trailing 30 days (baseline). 2 extra API calls per
repo; fail-open 0. `commit_heat()` compares the two so naturally-busy
repos don't auto-win — a repo is judged against itself.

description.description:
Repo-about facts (API-native, free in the same responses).
Display/classification only, never scored. Stripped with private nodes.

focus.description:
Captured focus as of `generated_at` (same formula as `focus()`).
Frozen at collection; the offline `--format focus` path recomputes
it live from the inputs above.

fork.description: API-native fork flag. Rides along as fact, not verdict.

has_readme.description: Agent-parseability audit from the default-branch tree (free).

last_commit_at.description:
Latest default-branch commit date (from the velocity probes; one
unbounded probe only when the 30d window is empty). Idle and focus
measure from here — repo-level `pushed_at` moves on any branch push
and would read 0 idle while main sat still.

layer.description:
Structural role, set once at ingestion by `apply_layers` on the
true graph (private transit included) and preserved verbatim by
`public_subgraph` — so the value is identical in the briefing
lane and the committed file, regardless of render. Persisted so
layers are minable straight from the JSON (`jq` on `.layer`).
Stated cost: a public `application -> middleware` value can reflect
a private dependent (never which one, no counts).

pushed_at.description:
Last push to the repo (API `pushed_at`). Display fact only, never scored.
Free in the enumerate/get responses — staleness/heartbeat signal.

stars.description:
Tier-0 magnet signals: free in enumerate/get (+ tree for has_*).
Display/classification only, never scored. Stripped with private nodes.

upstream.description: Upstream full name when `fork == true` (if known).

visible.description: Computed visibility: renderers filter blindly on this, never re-decide.

visible_reason.description: Why visible / hidden — machine-readable for the briefing digest.
